pc <- c(0.70, 0.18, 0.09, 0.02, 0.01)

  pc <- as.numeric(scenarios1[2*i - 1, 1:5])
  pt <- as.numeric(scenarios1[2*i, 1:5])
  PPO_ctl_leq <- cumsum(pc)
  PPO_trt_leq <- cumsum(pt)
  PPO_ctl_geq <- revcumsum(pc)
  PPO_trt_geq <- revcumsum(pt)
  p_y_ctl <- pc
  p_y_trt <- pt

  c <- 5
  j <- 1:(c-1)
  k <- 2:c

OR_le <- (PPO_trt_leq / (1- PPO_trt_leq)) / (PPO_ctl_leq / (1- PPO_ctl_leq))
OR_ge <- (PPO_ctl_geq / (1- PPO_ctl_geq)) / (PPO_trt_geq / (1- PPO_trt_geq))

true_ORs[i,] <- OR_le
# # calculate RR 
  log_RR_le <- log(PPO_trt_leq/PPO_ctl_leq)
  
true_RRs[i,] <- log_RR_le

#calculate weighted OR 
  # fully bayesian with both cumulative and split weights
  numerator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                     (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * 
                     (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])) * log(OR_le[j]))
  denominator <- sum((p_y_ctl[j] + p_y_ctl[k]) * 
                       (abs(utility[j] - utility[k])) * (PPO_ctl_leq[j] * (1-PPO_ctl_leq[j])))
wOR_100_75_50_25_0[i] <- exp(numerator/denominator)

# true power

l <- 1:5

covid_scenarios <- sim_results %>%
  mutate(Scenario = as.factor(case_when(array %in% 1:40 ~ "Null",

covid_scenarios$Scenario <- factor(covid_scenarios$Scenario, levels = c("Null", "Low PO", "High PO",
                                                                "NP 1", "NP 2",
                                                                "NP 3", "NP 4", "NP 5",

adj_vs_unadj_table <- covid_scenarios %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>% 
  merge(true_ORs, by = "Scenario") %>% 
  merge(true_vals, by = "Scenario") %>% 
  mutate(bias_OR1 = log_OR1_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_OR1),
         bias_OR1unadj = log_OR1_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log(true_OR1),
         bias_OR2 = log_OR2_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_OR2),
         bias_OR2unadj = log_OR2_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log(true_OR2),
         bias_OR3 = log_OR3_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_OR3),
         bias_OR3unadj = log_OR3_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log(true_OR3),
         bias_OR4 = log_OR4_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_OR4),
         bias_OR4unadj = log_OR4_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log(true_OR4),
         bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0 = log_weighted_OR_both_100_75_50_25_0 - log(true_wOR_100_75_50_25_0),
         bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0unadj = weighted_log_OR_both_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log(true_wOR_100_75_50_25_0), 
         CIwidth_OR1 = log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR1unadj = log_OR_CI2_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log_OR_CI1_100_75_50_25_0unadj,
         CIwidth_OR2 = log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR2unadj = log_OR_CI4_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log_OR_CI3_100_75_50_25_0unadj,
         CIwidth_OR3 = log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR3unadj = log_OR_CI6_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log_OR_CI5_100_75_50_25_0unadj,
         CIwidth_OR4 = log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0 - log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0,
         CIwidth_OR4unadj = log_OR_CI8_100_75_50_25_0unadj - log_OR_CI7_100_75_50_25_0unadj,
         CI_width_wOR = `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` -
           `log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0`,
         CI_width_wOR_unadj = `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0unadj` -
           `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0unadj`) %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
            OR1_adj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR1^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR1))),
            OR1_unadj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR1unadj^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR1unadj))),
            OR2_adj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR2^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR2))),
            OR2_unadj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR2unadj^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR2unadj))),
            OR3_adj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR3^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR3))),
            OR3_unadj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR3unadj^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR3unadj))),
            OR4_adj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR4^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR4))),
            OR4_unadj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_OR4unadj^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_OR4unadj))),
            wOR_adj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0))),
            wOR_unadj_RMSE = sqrt(sum(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0unadj^2) / sum(!is.na(bias_wOR_100_75_50_25_0unadj))),
            OR1_adj_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0 > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0 > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0 < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI2_100_75_50_25_0 < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI1_100_75_50_25_0)),
            OR2_adj_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0 > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0 > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0 < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI4_100_75_50_25_0 < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI3_100_75_50_25_0)),
            OR3_adj_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0 > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0 > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0 < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI6_100_75_50_25_0 < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI5_100_75_50_25_0)),
            OR4_adj_Power = sum((log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0 > 0 & 
                          log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0 > 0) |
                            (log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0 < 0 &
                          log_OR_95CI8_100_75_50_25_0 < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_95CI7_100_75_50_25_0)),
            wOR_adj_Power = sum((`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0 & 
                          `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` > 0) |
                            (`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0 &
                          `log_wOR_both_95CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`log_wOR_both_95CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0`)),
            OR1_unadj_Power = sum((log_OR_CI1_100_75_50_25_0unadj > 0 & 
                          log_OR_CI2_100_75_50_25_0unadj > 0) |
                            (log_OR_CI1_100_75_50_25_0unadj < 0 &
                          log_OR_CI2_100_75_50_25_0unadj < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_CI1_100_75_50_25_0unadj)),
            OR2_unadj_Power = sum((log_OR_CI3_100_75_50_25_0unadj > 0 & 
                          log_OR_CI4_100_75_50_25_0unadj > 0) |
                            (log_OR_CI3_100_75_50_25_0unadj < 0 &
                          log_OR_CI4_100_75_50_25_0unadj < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_CI3_100_75_50_25_0unadj)),
            OR3_unadj_Power = sum((log_OR_CI5_100_75_50_25_0unadj > 0 & 
                          log_OR_CI6_100_75_50_25_0unadj > 0) |
                            (log_OR_CI5_100_75_50_25_0unadj < 0 &
                          log_OR_CI6_100_75_50_25_0unadj < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_CI5_100_75_50_25_0unadj)),
            OR4_unadj_Power = sum((log_OR_CI7_100_75_50_25_0unadj > 0 & 
                          log_OR_CI8_100_75_50_25_0unadj > 0) |
                            (log_OR_CI7_100_75_50_25_0unadj < 0 &
                          log_OR_CI8_100_75_50_25_0unadj < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(log_OR_CI7_100_75_50_25_0unadj)),
            wOR_unadj_Power = sum((`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0unadj` > 0 & 
                          `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0unadj` > 0) |
                            (`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0unadj` < 0 &
                          `weighted_log_OR_both_CI.97.5%_100_75_50_25_0unadj` < 0) , na.rm = T)/
                      sum(!is.na(`weighted_log_OR_both_CI.2.5%_100_75_50_25_0unadj`)), 
            OR1_adj_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR1),
            OR1_unadj_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR1unadj),
            OR2_adj_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR2),
            OR2_unadj_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR2unadj),
            OR3_adj_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR3),
            OR3_unadj_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR3unadj),
            OR4_adj_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR4),
            OR4_unadj_CIwidth = mean(CIwidth_OR4unadj),
            wOR_adj_CIwidth = mean(CI_width_wOR),
            wOR_unadj_CIwidth = mean(CI_width_wOR_unadj)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Scenario,
               names_to = "Measure",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  separate(Measure, c("Summary", "Model", "Measure")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Measure", values_from = "Value") %>%

true_power2_100_75_50_25_0 <- true_power2_100_75_50_25_0 %>%
  rename(expected_power2 = true_power2_100_75_50_25_0)

true_power2_100_90_80_60_0 <- as.data.frame(true_power2_100_90_80_60_0)
true_power2_100_90_80_60_0$Utilities <- "100, 90, 80, 60, 0"

true_power <- true_power %>%

                                        "NP 2", "NP 3", "NP 4", "NP 5", "NP 6")))
  
util_table %>% filter(Summary == "wOR") %>%
  merge(true_power, by = c("Scenario", "Utilities")) %>%
  merge(true_power2, by = c("Scenario", "Utilities")) %>%
  arrange(factor(Scenario, levels = c("Null", "Low PO", "High PO", "NP 1", 
                                        "NP 2", "NP 3", "NP 4", "NP 5", "NP 6"))) %>%
  relocate(Power, .after = CIwidth) %>%
  rename("Expected Power Null" = expected_power,
         "Expected Power alt" = expected_power2) %>%
  kable(caption = "Different Utilites Adjusted Simulation", 
      booktabs = T, align = "c", digits = 2, linesep = "")
